comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/256580493 (Seven Springs Mountain Resort): the front side above the main lodge, the summit with the Tahoe Lodge, the Southwind village and the North Face on Laurel Hill, on one ticket and one map (Epic); it holds every lift and run. Hidden Valley Resort, a separate resort 5 km north-east on the same ridge, is a listed neighbour (resorts.json): its polygon's west tip reaches the box's north-east corner and the rest lies in the Overpass window. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-12 against Seven Springs' Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251205_SN_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the winter map 7springs.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links; the site serves curl an error page, so the page was read with WebFetch and the painting from its full-size copy on the resort's image server, scene7, 4200 x 2133 px, tile by tile). Its legend: Easier (green circle), More Difficult (blue square), Most Difficult (one black diamond) and two black diamonds ('provides a much higher level of challenge and risk'), as OSM's easy, intermediate, advanced and expert; Freestyle Terrain (orange, sized XS, SM, MD and LRG) and Slow Skiing Zone (hatching); its lifts the Avalanche, Tyrol, Cortina, Southwind, Polar Bear Express, Blitzen, North Pole, North Face, Giant Steps and Gunnar lifts, Santa's Beard Rope Tow and the Stowe Beginner, Tyrol and Easy Rider conveyors of the three beginner areas. The resort's lift and terrain status loads by script, so the printed map is the only source and wins. OpenStreetMap draws most runs twice, as a line and as an outline (area=yes) with the same tags; each override names both ways. Of OSM's named runs, all carry the map's rating but five short pieces at the runs' ends rated easy (Avalanche Slope 47 m, Goosebumps Slope 12 m, Tyrol Slope 32 m, Wagner Slope 37 m and Yodeler Trail's 69 m link from Turtleneck Glades with its small outline), flat links at the lift tops and the bases that orient.py leaves without a direction, set to their run's rating on the map. Names from the map: Southwind Lift (OSM Soutwind Lift), and the Southwind village's three ski-ways, which OSM names Southwind Village Trail, Soutwind Village Trail and E Southwind Village Trail and the map Tunnel, Gully and Bridge: matched by OSM's own structures (the way under the Southwind Circle and Southwind Drive road bridges is Tunnel, the way over the Southwind Drive road tunnel is Bridge) and by their order from the lift. Hidden as a description the map does not print: North Face Lifts, the run-out along the bottom of the North Face to the lifts. Names that differ from the map only by a space stay as OSM has them (North Face Bypass Trail and Little North Face Glades for NORTHFACE, Yodeler By Pass for YODELER BYPASS), as do the parks' longer names (Santa's Beard Terrain Park and Arctic Blast Children's Park for SANTA'S BEARD, SM, and ARCTIC BLAST, XS) and Great Western Trail, the summit traverse towards Lost Girl Trail, which the map draws without a name. Parks: Santa's Beard, Arctic Blast, Foggy Bowl, The Spot and The Alley are snow parks in OSM; Alpine Meadows Glades, a double-black glade on the map that OSM tags snow_park on its outline (its line is piste:type=backcountry and left out by the type rule), and the Stowe Beginner Area, beginner area 1 in the map's green, which OSM tags snow_park with the difficulty 'beginner', lose the park flag (the beginner area rated easy). Hidden: the five glades' wood outlines (Avalanche, Tyrol, Little North Face, Turtleneck and Turtle Claw Glades), closed ways without area=yes that carry the run's tags and would draw as runs looping round the woods, as Copper Mountain's and Okemo's are (each glade keeps its line), and the snow tubing area's two carpets, which the map's lift list does not name, as Vail's and Keystone's tubing carpets are. The 181 m stretch of Lost Girl Trail OSM tags nordic at the summit is left out by the type rule, as are the tubing lanes and the Orange XC Trail. OSM gaps (shipped as at Palisades Tahoe): Helen's Trail (green, below Helen's), North Park (MD, between Little North Face Slope and the North Pole Lift) and the Easy Rider Beginner Area are not named in OSM.
